# Golden Hour Wellness Colorado, LLC

> A therapist-owned counseling practice serving clients across Colorado,
> specializing in trauma and EMDR therapy, addiction counseling, anxiety and
> depression, and couples work. Founded by Shayla Martinez-O'Brien, LPC.

## Key facts

- Location: Colorado, United States. Services are available only to people
  physically located in Colorado, because clinician licensure is state-based.
- Formats: individual therapy in person and by telehealth; one virtual group.
- Insurance: in-network with Aetna, United Healthcare and Cigna for individual
  therapy. Insurance is NOT accepted for the group, which is self-pay.
- Phone: (303) 736-9822
- Email: goldenhourwellco@gmail.com
- First step: a free 15-minute consultation.

## Clinicians

- Shayla Martinez-O'Brien, LPC — founder, 11 years of practice.
  Trauma, EMDR and addiction. Accepts individual clients.
- Chrissie Flynn-Weirich, LAC — Wellness Facilitator, 13+ years.
  Substance use, anxiety, life transitions. Accepts individual clients.
- Ashley LeRossignol, LPC — consultant and group co-facilitator.
  Does NOT accept individual clients through this practice.

## Services

- [Trauma & EMDR](https://www.goldenhourwellnesscolorado.com/trauma-emdr.html)
- [Anxiety & Depression](https://www.goldenhourwellnesscolorado.com/anxiety-depression.html)
- [Substance Use & Recovery](https://www.goldenhourwellnesscolorado.com/substance-use.html)
- [Couples & Relationships](https://www.goldenhourwellnesscolorado.com/couples-therapy.html)
- [Mama's Golden Hour](https://www.goldenhourwellnesscolorado.com/mamas-golden-hour.html) — six-week virtual
  therapy group for Colorado mothers. Next cohort starts Wednesday
  7 October 2026, 6:00pm Mountain Time. $25 per session or $150 for six weeks.

## Important

This practice does not claim a perinatal mental health credential. The mothers'
group is a therapy group facilitated by licensed clinicians, not a specialist
perinatal treatment programme.

Crisis resources: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, or Colorado Crisis Services
at 1-844-493-8255. This website is not monitored for emergencies.
